narr: A thunderstorm moved through Lake Charles causing flooding in south sections of the city.
ev: A quick 5 to 6 inches of rain produced street flooding in south Lake Charles near Barb High School. The emergency manager reported water began to enter his residence near the school.
lsr: EMERGENCY MANAGER REPORTS HEAVY RAIN NEAR BARBE HIGH SCHOOL. ROAD HAS 5 TO 6 INCHES OF RAIN ON IT AND IT IS ENTERING HIS HOUSE.
